method_notes: Breadth-first census compiled 2026-09-20 from live fetches of operator, venue and governing-body sites, with Wikipedia used only where a first-party figure was unavailable (marked GRADE_B). The 59-course British racecourse list was taken from the Wikipedia List of British racecourses table and cross-checked against the RCA/BHA count (Jockey Club 14, ARC 16, 27 independent); Down Royal and Downpatrick were added for Northern Ireland, giving 61 racecourses. Racecourses, circuits and greyhound stadiums almost never publish a single spectator capacity, so capacity_value is null and capacity_confidence is CAPACITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED for the large majority; where a venue stated an attendance band or licensed figure (Taunton 10,000 licensed; Salisbury 2,000-9,000; Chester 20,000+ per race day; Fakenham 1,500-4,500+; Epsom 28,000+ on Derby Day) that wording is preserved verbatim in scale_description rather than converted into a number. Three operators share one site platform each, which matters for ingestion: Jockey Club Racecourses (thejockeyclub.co.uk/<course>/events-tickets/, verified on Cheltenham, Aintree, Epsom, Newmarket, Haydock, Sandown), Arena Racing Company (per-course domains with /whats-on and /popular-events/live-music, verified on Doncaster and Chepstow) and MotorSport Vision (per-circuit domains with /calendar, verified on Brands Hatch, Donington, Oulton Park, Snetterton, Cadwell Park). Where a sibling venue site was not individually fetched, the calendar_sources note says so explicitly.
